title: Add bin/greet, which greets a name
goal: The greet command is the whole product. This task adds the script that prints the greeting, so a later task can add the shout option on top of it.
acceptance: bin/greet is a new file in the repository
bin/greet world prints exactly hello, world and exits 0
bin/greet with no argument prints usage: greet <name> on stderr, prints nothing on stdout and exits 2
verify: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- bin)" && sh bin/greet world | grep -qx 'hello, world'
